newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech c.bank sets liquidity bill auction for Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Czech c.bank sets liquidity bill auction for Thurs.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) will auction an eight billion crown tranche of 13-week liquidity bills on Thursday with a limit price on bids equal to a maximum yield of 13.50 percent.
The CNB said in a statement that bids in the Dutch-style auction are due by 1300 local time (1100 GMT) on Thursday.
The nearest relevant maturity on the Prague Interbank Offered Rate (PRIBOR), one-month money, stood at 12.67 percent on Wednesday down one basis basis point from Tuesday.
